The canonical (Aron–Berner) extension

For z\in X^{**} and a continuous (m+1)-linear form C on X, one step of the extension is the m-linear form (v_1,\ldots,v_m)\longmapsto z\bigl(v\mapsto C(v_1,\ldots,v_m,v)\bigr) (eq:partial). Iterating it n times extends the last variable first and gives \overline A(z,\ldots,z), the value at the diagonal point of the canonical extension (eq:arens, eq:AB). For a vector-valued polynomial the extension \widetilde P\colon X^{**}\to Y^{**} is defined by \widetilde P(z)(y^*)=\widetilde{y^*\circ P}(z) (eq:ABvector).

The bidual X**.

abbrev Bidual (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (X : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] := StrongDual 𝕜 (StrongDual 𝕜 X)

One step of the canonical extension (eq:partial): (extLast z C)(v₁,…,vₘ) = z (v ↦ C(v₁,…,vₘ,v)).

def extLast (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m := z.compContinuousMultilinearMap C.curryRight
lemma extLast_apply (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) (v : Fin m → X) : extLast z C v = z (C.curryRight v) := rfllemma curryRight_apply' {m : ℕ} (C : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) (v : Fin m → X) (x : X) : C.curryRight v x = C (Fin.snoc v x) := ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryRight_apply _ _ _lemma extLast_add (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {m : ℕ} (C D : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)) : extLast z (C + D) = extLast z C + extLast z D := 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xz:Bidual 𝕜 Xm:ℕC:MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)D:MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)⊢ extLast z (C + D) = extLast z C + extLast z D 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xz:Bidual 𝕜 Xm:ℕC:MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)D:MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)v:Fin m → X⊢ (extLast z (C + D)) v = (extLast z C + extLast z D) v 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xz:Bidual 𝕜 Xm:ℕC:MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)D:MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)v:Fin m → X⊢ z ((ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryRight (C + D)) v) = z ((ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryRight C) v) + z ((ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryRight D) v) 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xz:Bidual 𝕜 Xm:ℕC:MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)D:MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 (m + 1)v:Fin m → X⊢ z ((ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryRight (C + D)) v) = z ((ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryRight C) v + (ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryRight D) v) All goals completed! The value Ā(z,…,z) of the canonical extension of an m-linear form at the diagonal.

def diagExt (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) : ∀ {m : ℕ}, MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 m → 𝕜 | 0, C => C (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) | _ + 1, C => diagExt z (extLast z C)

The canonical extension extends: Ā(Jx,…,Jx) = A(x,…,x).

The vector-valued canonical extension at the diagonal (eq:ABvector): (diagExtV z A)(y*) = (y* ∘ A)‾(z,…,z).

def diagExtV (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {n : ℕ} (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : Bidual 𝕜 Y := LinearMap.mkContinuous { toFun := fun g => diagExt z (g.compContinuousMultilinearMap A) map_add' := fun g h => 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝⁴:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝³:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝²:NormedSpace 𝕜 XY:Type u_3inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Yinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Yz:Bidual 𝕜 Xn:ℕA:MLin 𝕜 X Y ng:StrongDual 𝕜 Yh:StrongDual 𝕜 Y⊢ diagExt z (ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap (g + h) A) = diagExt z (ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap g A) + diagExt z (ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap h A) 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝⁴:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝³:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝²:NormedSpace 𝕜 XY:Type u_3inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Yinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Yz:Bidual 𝕜 Xn:ℕA:MLin 𝕜 X Y ng:StrongDual 𝕜 Yh:StrongDual 𝕜 Y⊢ diagExt z (ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap (g + h) A) = diagExt z (ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap g A + ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap h A) All goals completed! lemma diagExtV_apply (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) {n : ℕ} (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) : diagExtV z A g = diagExt z (g.compContinuousMultilinearMap A) := rfl

Polynomials as functions and their symmetric forms

The symmetric n-linear form Ǎ associated with a homogeneous polynomial P (the symmetrization of any L with P = L(x,…,x); junk value 0 if P is not a continuous n-homogeneous polynomial).

def symmForm (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] {Y : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace 𝕜 Y] (n : ℕ) (P : X → Y) : MLin 𝕜 X Y n := haveI := Classical.propDecidable (IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P) if h : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P then symmetrize (Classical.choose h) else 0
variable {n : ℕ}lemma isSymm_symmForm (P : X → Y) : IsSymm (symmForm 𝕜 n P) := 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝⁴:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝³:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝²:NormedSpace 𝕜 XY:Type u_3inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Yinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Yn:ℕP:X → Y⊢ IsSymm (symmForm 𝕜 n P) 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝⁴:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝³:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝²:NormedSpace 𝕜 XY:Type u_3inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Yinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Yn:ℕP:X → Y⊢ IsSymm (if h : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P then symmetrize (Classical.choose h) else 0) 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝⁴:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝³:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝²:NormedSpace 𝕜 XY:Type u_3inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Yinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Yn:ℕP:X → Yh:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P⊢ IsSymm (symmetrize (Classical.choose h))𝕜:Type u_1inst✝⁴:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝³:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝²:NormedSpace 𝕜 XY:Type u_3inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Yinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Yn:ℕP:X → Yh:¬IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P⊢ IsSymm 0 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝⁴:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝³:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝²:NormedSpace 𝕜 XY:Type u_3inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Yinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Yn:ℕP:X → Yh:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P⊢ IsSymm (symmetrize (Classical.choose h)) All goals completed! 🐙 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝⁴:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝³:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝²:NormedSpace 𝕜 XY:Type u_3inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Yinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Yn:ℕP:X → Yh:¬IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P⊢ IsSymm 0 All goals completed! 🐙lemma diag_symmForm {P : X → Y} (hP : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P) : diag (symmForm 𝕜 n P) = P := 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝⁴:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝³:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝²:NormedSpace 𝕜 XY:Type u_3inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Yinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Yn:ℕP:X → YhP:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P⊢ diag (symmForm 𝕜 n P) = P 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝⁴:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝³:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝²:NormedSpace 𝕜 XY:Type u_3inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Yinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Yn:ℕP:X → YhP:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P⊢ diag (if h : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P then symmetrize (Classical.choose h) else 0) = P 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝⁴:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝³:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝²:NormedSpace 𝕜 XY:Type u_3inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Yinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Yn:ℕP:X → YhP:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P⊢ diag (Classical.choose hP) = P 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝⁴:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝³:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝²:NormedSpace 𝕜 XY:Type u_3inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Yinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Yn:ℕP:X → YhP:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n Px:X⊢ diag (Classical.choose hP) x = P x All goals completed! 🐙lemma isHomPoly_diag (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n) : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n (diag A) := ⟨A, fun _ => rfl⟩

The symmetric form is the unique symmetric n-linear map with diagonal P.

lemma symmForm_eq_of_isSymm {A : MLin 𝕜 X Y n} (hA : IsSymm A) : symmForm 𝕜 n (diag A) = A := eq_of_diag_eq (isSymm_symmForm _) hA (diag_symmForm (isHomPoly_diag A))
lemma symmForm_comp {P : X → Y} (hP : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P) (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) : symmForm 𝕜 n (fun x => g (P x)) = g.compContinuousMultilinearMap (symmForm 𝕜 n P) := 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝⁴:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝³:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝²:NormedSpace 𝕜 XY:Type u_3inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Yinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Yn:ℕP:X → YhP:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n Pg:StrongDual 𝕜 Y⊢ (symmForm 𝕜 n fun x ↦ g (P x)) = ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap g (symmForm 𝕜 n P) 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝⁴:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝³:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝²:NormedSpace 𝕜 XY:Type u_3inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Yinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Yn:ℕP:X → YhP:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n Pg:StrongDual 𝕜 Yh1:(fun x ↦ g (P x)) = diag (ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap g (symmForm 𝕜 n P))⊢ (symmForm 𝕜 n fun x ↦ g (P x)) = ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap g (symmForm 𝕜 n P) All goals completed! 🐙

The canonical (Aron–Berner) extension P̃ : X** → 𝕜 of a scalar polynomial P: P̃(z) = Ā(z,…,z) with A = Ǎ (eq:AB).

def abExt (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] (n : ℕ) (P : X → 𝕜) (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) : 𝕜 := diagExt z (symmForm 𝕜 n P)

The canonical (Aron–Berner) extension P̃ : X** → Y** of a vector-valued polynomial: P̃(z)(y*) = (y* ∘ P)~(z) (eq:ABvector); see abExtV_apply.

def abExtV (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] {Y : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace 𝕜 Y] (n : ℕ) (P : X → Y) (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) : Bidual 𝕜 Y := diagExtV z (symmForm 𝕜 n P)

The defining property P̃(z)(y*) = (y* ∘ P)~(z) of the vector-valued extension.

theorem abExtV_apply {P : X → Y} (hP : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P) (z : Bidual 𝕜 X) (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) : abExtV 𝕜 n P z g = abExt 𝕜 n (fun x => g (P x)) z := 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝⁴:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝³:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝²:NormedSpace 𝕜 XY:Type u_3inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Yinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Yn:ℕP:X → YhP:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n Pz:Bidual 𝕜 Xg:StrongDual 𝕜 Y⊢ (abExtV 𝕜 n P z) g = abExt 𝕜 n (fun x ↦ g (P x)) z All goals completed! 🐙

The canonical extension extends P: P̃(Jx) = P(x).

theorem abExt_inclusion {P : X → 𝕜} (hP : IsHomPoly 𝕜 n P) (x : X) : abExt 𝕜 n P (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual 𝕜 X x) = P x := 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xn:ℕP:X → 𝕜hP:IsHomPoly 𝕜 n Px:X⊢ abExt 𝕜 n P ((NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual 𝕜 X) x) = P x All goals completed! 🐙
